Implementation Plan

Planning ref: `orchestrator/project-2511` @ `eeea02a97d24f0da1f50a8beb183e22878d890ca`  
Integration metadata matches the checked-out ref, so planning can proceed normally.

Clarification mapping
- No `Q1`/`Q2` clarification questions were asked in clarify.
- The `/answer [auto-answered-by-orchestrator]` comment is therefore interpreted as “proceed with the issue body as authoritative”; it does not add or change scope.

Representative pattern to follow
- Use the existing implement-phase Semble wiring in `.github/workflows/implement.yml` as the structural model for workflow/env/bootstrap changes.
- Use the existing shared placeholder handling in `scripts/render_prompt.sh` plus its contract coverage in `tests/test_judge_semble_prefetch_contract.py` as the model for the new Serena placeholder behavior.

Assumptions made due to ambiguity
- “Run `scripts/setup_serena.sh` after the cheap implement exits” is interpreted conservatively as: do not run Serena setup on early skip/duplicate-PR/closed-issue/phase-label exit paths; place the live setup step only after the workflow has committed to running the editor, and after `Create Codex config`.
- “Widen the setup-uv/install gate” is interpreted as widening the generic prerequisite gate needed for Serena bootstrap, while keeping Semble-only work Semble-scoped unless an explicit early-exit keeps Serena-only runs from installing Semble unnecessarily.
- No explicit `files_touched:` block was provided in the issue body, so scope is constrained to the workflow/prompt/render/test files directly required by the requested implement-family plumbing.

Files likely to change
1. `.github/workflows/implement.yml`
   - Add `SERENA_ENABLED` repo-var plumbing with a default of `'false'`.
   - Seed fail-open runtime env for Serena availability in `Create runtime workspace`.
   - Extend `Stage workflow support files` to stage Serena support assets for consumer-repo runs.
   - Widen the prerequisite gate(s) needed before Serena bootstrap.
   - Add a dedicated Serena setup step after `Create Codex config`.
   - Pass Serena hint env into live prompt rendering paths.
   - Emit Serena stats on an `always()` path before cleanup.
   - Exclude runtime `.serena/` artifacts from pre-Codex baseline/no-op detection logic.

2. `scripts/render_prompt.sh`
   - Add `{{SERENA_TOOL_HINTS}}` placeholder support with empty substitution when unavailable.
   - Preserve the existing standalone-placeholder resolution model and unresolved-placeholder guards.

3. `scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh`
   - Pass the Serena hint env through the diagnose prompt render path.
   - Preserve additive config patching behavior around `~/.codex/config.toml` so an existing `[mcp_servers.serena]` block survives diagnose-time reasoning patching.

4. `prompts/mode-implement.txt`
   - Add the shared Serena hint section for the prompt contract.

5. `prompts/mode-implement-diagnose.txt`
   - Add Serena guidance for the diagnose role.

6. `prompts/mode-implement-repair.txt`
   - Add Serena guidance for the live post-Codex repair role.

7. `prompts/mode-implement-repair-syntax.txt`
   - Add Serena guidance for contract parity with the implement-family repair prompts.

8. Test files, most likely by extending existing focused contract harnesses:
   - `tests/test_implement_semble_contract.py`
   - `tests/test_judge_semble_prefetch_contract.py`
   - `tests/test_implement_post_codex_recovery.py`
   - possibly one focused regression test addition for diagnose/repair config preservation if the existing suites do not already cover it

Functions / modules to implement
1. Workflow env and bootstrap wiring in `.github/workflows/implement.yml`
   - Top-level env: add `SERENA_ENABLED: ${{ vars.SERENA_ENABLED || 'false' }}`
   - `Create runtime workspace`: export a fail-open Serena runtime default, analogous to existing Semble availability defaults
   - `Stage workflow support files`:
     - stage top-level Serena helpers already present on this ref (`scripts/setup_serena.sh`, `scripts/serena_stats_emit.py`, `scripts/mcp_handshake_probe.py`)
     - stage the nested template dependency used by `setup_serena.sh` (`scripts/templates/serena_project.yml.j2`)
     - keep consumer-repo cleanup behavior intact so fetched support assets are not committed back to callers
   - `setup-uv` and any shared prerequisite gate:
     - widen the predicate so Serena-enabled runs get `uv` before `setup_serena.sh`
     - avoid broadening Semble-only index creation unless the step has an explicit no-op when Semble is disabled
   - Add `Setup Serena` step:
     - place it after `Create Codex config`
     - run `bash scripts/setup_serena.sh`
     - keep it fail-soft so `SERENA_AVAILABLE=false` remains the fallback on install/probe/config failures
   - Add an `always()` Serena stats step before `Cleanup temporary artifacts`:
     - use existing `scripts/serena_stats_emit.py`
     - aggregate whatever implement-family logs exist for the run
     - fail open if logs or helper are missing

2. Shared prompt rendering contract in `scripts/render_prompt.sh`
   - Add a new env-backed block, analogous to `SEMBLE_PREFETCH`, for `SERENA_TOOL_HINTS`
   - Preserve current behavior:
     - placeholder resolves only when the trimmed line is exactly the placeholder token
     - empty/unset value removes the placeholder line cleanly
     - unresolved-placeholder guards still fail if a standalone placeholder survives rendering

3. Live prompt render callers
   - Main implement prompt in `.github/workflows/implement.yml`:
     - the current live prompt is an inline heredoc rendered via `scripts/render_prompt.sh`
     - it needs explicit `SERENA_TOOL_HINTS=...` passthrough when the prompt body gains the new placeholder
   - Diagnose prompt in `scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh`:
     - currently rendered through `scripts/render_prompt.sh`
     - needs the same env passthrough
   - Post-Codex repair prompt in `.github/workflows/implement.yml`:
     - this is the important non-obvious caller
     - it currently concatenates `prompts/mode-implement-repair.txt` directly into the repair prompt file rather than rendering it first
     - if `prompts/mode-implement-repair.txt` gets `{{SERENA_TOOL_HINTS}}`, this step must render the template first or the placeholder will remain literal

4. Prompt content updates
   - Add a short Serena hint section to the four prompt files named in the issue
   - Guidance should prefer Serena symbol lookup/navigation when available
   - Guidance must still keep `apply_patch` as the primary write path, matching the issue’s implementation discipline

5. Config preservation guard
   - Diagnose script:
     - the current `patch_diagnose_reasoning_into_config()` logic appears additive rather than destructive
     - keep that property explicit and tested so an existing `[mcp_servers.serena]` block is not lost
   - Repair logic in `.github/workflows/implement.yml`:
     - same requirement for the in-workflow `REPAIR_CODEX_CONFIG` reasoning patch block
   - Given current code shape, this likely needs regression coverage more than a broad logic rewrite

6. `.serena/` runtime-artifact handling for no-op detection
   - The pre-Codex baseline and baseline-relative delta logic in `Run Codex implementation` currently treats runtime workspace artifacts specially via the captured baseline
   - After Serena is introduced, runtime-generated `.serena/project.yml` must not create false “Codex changed files” / “not a no-op” signals
   - Update the baseline/no-op path so `.serena/` is treated like other workflow-generated noise for detection purposes

Data structures affected
- GitHub Actions env / repo vars:
  - new top-level `SERENA_ENABLED`
  - existing runtime `SERENA_AVAILABLE` produced by `scripts/setup_serena.sh`
  - transient `SERENA_TOOL_HINTS` env passed to prompt render calls
- Prompt placeholder catalog recognized by `scripts/render_prompt.sh`
  - new shared token: `{{SERENA_TOOL_HINTS}}`
- Codex config file:
  - `~/.codex/config.toml`
  - must preserve both `model_reasoning_effort` and any appended `[mcp_servers.serena]` table
- Runtime artifacts:
  - `.serena/project.yml` in the workspace
  - staged support files and fetched-manifest entries for consumer-repo runs

API / interface changes
- Workflow interface change only:
  - new repo-variable/env contract: `SERENA_ENABLED` defaults to off
- Shared prompt-render contract change:
  - `scripts/render_prompt.sh` will support `{{SERENA_TOOL_HINTS}}`
- No user-facing HTTP/API/schema changes are required by this issue

Potential risks / edge cases
1. Main prompt source mismatch
   - `prompts/mode-implement.txt` exists, but the live implement workflow currently renders an inline heredoc (`PROMPT_TEMPLATE_FILE="${RUNTIME_DIR}/mode-implement-inline.txt"`).
   - Editing `prompts/mode-implement.txt` alone will not affect runtime behavior.

2. Repair prompt render gap
   - `prompts/mode-implement-repair.txt` is live, but it is not currently passed through `render_prompt.sh`.
   - Without a render step, the new placeholder would be left unresolved in the actual repair prompt.

3. Non-live repair-syntax prompt
   - `prompts/mode-implement-repair-syntax.txt` is present, but there is no live implement workflow caller for it on this ref.
   - It should still be updated for contract parity, but no caller-side env change is required unless a caller is added later.

4. Serena assets already exist
   - `scripts/setup_serena.sh`, `scripts/serena_stats_emit.py`, `scripts/mcp_handshake_probe.py`, and the Serena template already exist on this ref.
   - The work here is workflow/bootstrap/prompt plumbing, not authoring those assets from scratch.

5. Gate widening can accidentally install Semble on Serena-only runs
   - Naively widening every Semble-gated step to `SEMBLE_ENABLED || SERENA_ENABLED` would cause Serena-only runs to execute Semble-specific steps.
   - Keep the widene
